parameters.query:
=WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE chatbot_logs
  SET satisfaction = '{{ $json.satisfaction }}',
      satisfaction_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = (
    SELECT id FROM chatbot_logs
    WHERE session_id = '{{ $json.sessionId }}'
    AND question = '{{ $json.question }}'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  RETURNING id, satisfaction
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT id::text FROM updated), '') AS log_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT satisfaction FROM updated), '') AS satisfaction,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN true ELSE false END AS updated
